Communication Strategies: The Fuel for Quality Coach-Athlete Relationships and Athlete Satisfaction
sources.authors: Davis L, Jowett S, Tafvelin S.

sources.title: A Comparison of Players' and Coaches' Perceptions of the Coach-Created Motivational Climate within Youth Soccer Teams
sources.authors: Møllerløkken NE, Lorås H, Pedersen AV.

sources.title: Effects of leadership style on coach-athlete relationship, athletes' motivations, and athlete satisfaction
sources.authors: Jin H, Kim S, Love A, Jin Y, Zhao J.

findings.finding: Coaches' autonomy-supportive behaviours, structure, and involvement benefit athletes' needs and nurture intrinsic motivation.
findings.quote: coaches' behaviours in the form of autonomy-supportive behaviours, provision of structure and involvement have a beneficial impact on athletes' needs for autonomy, competence and relatedness, which, in turn, nurture athletes' intrinsic motivation

findings.finding: Communication strategies help enhance the quality of the coach-athlete relationship and athlete sport satisfaction.
findings.quote: provide support for the practical utility of communications strategies in enhancing the quality of the coach-athlete relationship and athlete's experiences of sport satisfaction.

findings.finding: Players may perceive the motivational climate as more performance-oriented and less mastery-oriented than coaches perceive it to be.
findings.quote: players of both sexes perceived the motivational climate to be significantly more performance-oriented and significantly less mastery-oriented compared with the coaches.

findings.finding: Democratic leadership has a direct positive influence on the coach-athlete relationship.
findings.quote: The results indicated democratic leadership had a direct positive influence on the coach-athlete relationship, while autocratic leadership had no direct effect.

principle: Coaches support motivation and satisfaction through democratic leadership and autonomy-supportive behaviors that build a positive relationship.
for_the_teacher: Give learners choices during the lesson to support their autonomy and intrinsic motivation.
Use democratic approaches that allow learners to have a voice in their practice.
Communicate clearly and supportively to build a positive relationship and enhance satisfaction.
